build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many goals the opponent allows compared with the league. Then adjusted for how he has done against our own forecasts: 162 points against 153.2 forecast in his earlier games, shrunk toward no adjustment. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.

player_context.note: Newer appearances carry more weight. Ice time has a 14-appearance half-life; production per minute has a 110-appearance half-life. The offseason does not age player history. Expected shots scale with the opponent’s shots allowed, and scoring with its goals allowed, relative to the league. A player who has consistently beaten (or missed) our earlier forecasts gets a shrunk adjustment toward that record. Observed averages below are unweighted. sensitivity.assumption: Production/opportunity means ±10%; not a confidence interval

assessment.reason: The modest model-over-price margin survives the downside sensitivity, and no identified fact clearly breaks the case. It merits human consideration, not endorsement.
assessment.model_case: Projects about 0.45 assists on 16.4 minutes, using a 164-game history and a recent Oct 15 appearance. The main weakness is that line and power-play assignment are unverified, so the shrunk production rate assumes a normal role.
assessment.price_case: +235 on the main 0.5 line requires roughly a 3-in-10 hit rate. The model's fair price is about +178, with a floor near +209. The one other book sits close to the offered price, so this is not broad consensus.
assessment.context_case: Buffalo injury listings may reshuffle center and defense roles. That could shift McLeod's opportunity either way. His own status is not established by his absence from the table.

qualitative_review.countercase: The edge is thin and rests on one comparison book plus an experimental model. If Norris or Kulich returns and McLeod drops to a checking role, or Dahlin's absence weakens Buffalo's power play, his assist chances could fall toward the market view.
